prev_hash.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the previous record's canonical line; 64 '0' characters for the first record of the log.

actor.description: The operator's OS principal for an operator act, the role of a worker for a record its call caused, or the runtime for its own act.

details.description: Event-specific fields. A record of an operator act carries channel (cli or web) and, for web, device_id, and os_principal; a record caused by a worker's call carries job_id, role, harness, and generation_id; a machine-level record carries os_principal only; a checkpoint record carries the checkpoint fields.
